$comment: GENERATED by `pnpm gen:notification-href-fixture` from lib/notifications/hrefShapes.ts. Do not hand-edit: lib/notifications/hrefShapes.test.ts fails when this drifts from the registry. tovis-ios commits the same bytes at TovisTests/Fixtures/notificationHrefShapes.json and drives PushDeepLink over every `probe`. surface: native = a real screen (not home, not nil); shell = the role home IS the answer; web = the phone must NOT claim it (parser must return nil, so the tap stays harmless).

shapes.why: MESSAGE_RECEIVED and the waitlist notices open the conversation.
Every look-engagement notice points at the look it is about.
The re-engagement nudges send the client back to the pro profile.
The booking detail — payment notices, the AI consult invitation.
Appointment reminders and every confirm/reschedule/cancel notice.
AFTERCARE_READY — the aftercare tab of that booking.
CONSULTATION_PROPOSAL_SENT — the proposal awaiting a decision.
REVIEW_REQUESTED. The fragment is folded into `step` by the parser.
LOOK_BRIEF_REVIEW, AI_CONSULT_ANALYSIS_FAILED, the prep reminders.

AI_CONSULT_ANALYSIS_READY — the payoff of the whole consult chain. FOUR path parts: the parser needed a second arm for it, and this is the shape both sweeps missed because it is composed away from its event key.
CLIENT_FOLLOW — the activity feed.
REFERRAL_CONFIRMED / REFERRAL_CONVERTED.
REFERRAL_TAP_RECEIVED — the referral to confirm.
The waitlist time-offer notice, with no one recipient to float.
The priority offer — the id the offers screen floats and highlights.
EVENT_DATE_COUNTDOWN, whose body is an instruction to open the board.

CHART_ACCESS_REQUESTED — the consent surface that answers the ask. ⚠️ Only the path spelling is EMITTED, so only it is declared; rows minted before web split settings into a hub carry `/client/settings` with a `#chart-sharing` fragment instead, and the iOS parser still accepts that. This registry describes what web SENDS, not everything already in the database — do not read the omission as licence to drop the legacy arm.

LAST_MINUTE_OPENING_AVAILABLE. `openingId` is required, not incidental — the native screen renders one opening, and a bare /offerings/{id} has no native counterpart. The emitter also appends scheduledFor/source/proTimeZone, which no parser reads.
The last-minute job falls back to this when an opening has no offering to point at. There is nothing more specific to open, so the client shell IS the destination rather than a swallowed tap.
CLIENT_CLAIM_INVITE. Handled as a Universal LINK by ClaimLink; as a notification href it must stay unclaimed — the token is the whole flow.
AFTERCARE_ACCESS — a tokenised aftercare/rebook page, web-only.
DEPOSIT_PAYMENT_LINK — a tokenised payment page, web-only.
APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMATION — a tokenised confirm/decline page, web-only.
CONSENT_SIGNATURE — a tokenised consent form, web-only.
CONSULTATION_ACTION — a tokenised approve/reject page, web-only.
The pro-side booking detail — requests, reschedules, payments.
CONSULTATION_APPROVED / _REJECTED — the client answered the proposal.
LOOK_BRIEF_REVIEW and CONSULT_PRO_FOLLOW_UP, pro side.
REVIEW_RECEIVED, by path.
The same notice, minted with the web anchor instead. The parser lifts the id out of the fragment, so both spellings scroll to the review.
LOOK_FOLLOWER_NEW — the profile the new follower arrived at.
PRO_HANDLE_RESERVATION_EXPIRING.
The licence-expiry pair — the screen that takes the upload.
CHART_ACCESS_GRANTED — "You can now open their chart."
WAITLIST_CLIENT_LEFT / WAITLIST_OFFER_EXPIRED.
ADMIN_VIRAL_REQUEST_PENDING. No native admin app.
ADMIN_VERIFICATION_REVIEW_NEEDED. 🔴 One segment from /professionals/{id}, which the app DOES open — claiming it would show an admin the public profile instead of the review queue.
ADMIN_SUPPORT_TICKET_CREATED. No native admin app.
ADMIN_USER_SIGNED_UP. No native admin app.
The viral-request review queue. No native admin app.
